findings.expectedBehavior: A disconnected/disposed operation must not restore the old account, create pending intent or send a wager.
findings.observedBeforeFix: A microtask disconnect after _state returned could let refresh restore READY and enable SPIN/AUTO; spin and replay-miss branches had the same unguarded await boundary.
findings.reviewMethod: Independent recovery_peer read-only reproduction followed by parent-owned shared fixes and isolated regressions.
regressions: replay-miss disconnect retains old pending intent without resending
findings.verificationScope: Local isolated regression; no production actions.
findings.nextAction: No further code change identified for this defect; complete the separately listed browser/integration verification before release.

findings.expectedBehavior: An async lock-return continuation must not publish a receipt through a disconnected operation.
findings.observedBeforeFix: SETTLED observer scheduled disconnect; the outer spin/recover promise could return the old receipt after the lock resolved. No second debit occurred in the reproductions.
findings.reviewMethod: Independent recovery_peer reproduction plus focused regression.
regressions: spin/recover disconnect during lock return rejects STALE_OPERATION
accepted request remains settled and is not re-created
findings.verificationScope: Local isolated regression; no production actions.
findings.nextAction: No further code change identified for this defect; complete the separately listed browser/integration verification before release.

findings.expectedBehavior: A resumed attempted action must request recovery of the same completed/pending round without new input.
findings.observedBeforeFix: When after-input screenshot was saved but observeRound response was lost, resume passed recovery:false; the driver could not recover the already completed result.
regressions: lost completed-observation response uses same actionId and recovery:true with exactly seven total inputs
findings.verificationScope: Local isolated regression; no production actions.
findings.nextAction: No further code change identified for this defect; complete the separately listed browser/integration verification before release.

findings.expectedBehavior: Each attempted input must belong to one completed observation or the exact pending intent; corrupt state must remain unchanged and block interaction.
findings.observedBeforeFix: A missing/false/changed pending marker did not match the action journal, yet the coordinator resumed input; completed validation also accepted orphan attempted actions.
findings.reviewMethod: Four failing-before regressions; causal journal validation now runs before session interaction and rejects without rewriting the checkpoint.
findings.verificationScope: Local isolated regression; no production actions.
findings.nextAction: No further code change identified for this defect; complete the separately listed browser/integration verification before release.

findings.expectedBehavior: A failed persistent lock release must not leave an additional in-process concurrency slot permanently occupied.
findings.observedBeforeFix: An exception from release skipped running.delete; another run in the same coordinator failed even after the persistent lock was released.
findings.reviewMethod: Failing-before injected one-shot release failure; finally cleanup retested.
regressions: release IO failure followed by completed checkpoint resume without another input
findings.verificationScope: Local isolated regression; no production actions.
findings.nextAction: No further code change identified for this defect; complete the separately listed browser/integration verification before release.

findings.expectedBehavior: Invalid extra-round metadata must not half-commit the pending manual observation.
findings.observedBeforeFix: The manual round was appended before extra metadata validation; rejection saved that round while retaining the same pending action, blocking recovery as a duplicate.
findings.reviewMethod: Failing-before metadata rejection and same-action retest.
regressions: invalid extra metadata leaves zero committed rounds; corrected observation resumes exact input
findings.verificationScope: Local isolated regression; no production actions.
findings.nextAction: No further code change identified for this defect; complete the separately listed browser/integration verification before release.

findings.expectedBehavior: A control batch and its extra observations must commit together exactly once.
findings.observedBeforeFix: Malformed metadata in a later control left earlier controls/extra rounds persisted; read-only recovery could append them again and double-count an observed extra round.
findings.reviewMethod: Separate failing-before regression in release/capture-control-review-before-fix.tap; staged batch commit retested.
regressions: malformed control batch retains no partial records; read-only recovery yields two controls and one extra round with one control execution
findings.verificationScope: Local isolated regression; no production actions.
findings.nextAction: No further code change identified for this defect; complete the separately listed browser/integration verification before release.

lockingAndIntegrityLimits: Capture file locks are exclusive for cooperating processes. A stale crashed-owner lock is retained until its dead owner is verified; no bypass was added.
A changed capture session/target/viewport/version is rejected; saved original evidence is preserved.
Metadata consistency detects contradictory/orphaned records but cannot reconstruct deleted data or prove truthful observations.
Shared pending identity retains the original request, session guard and rules/engine/hash. A new session cannot silently acquire another guard's pending request.
No hash, provenance attribution, unit-test status or signature is treated as a complete fairness proof.
